# Aviation English

> ICAO-accredited aviation English training provider offering specialized courses for pilots, air traffic controllers, engineers, and cabin crew with locations in Hong Kong.

Aviation English Asia Ltd is a Hong Kong-based training organization specializing in ICAO Aviation English proficiency to meet international aviation communication standards. The site provides comprehensive courses ranging from entry-level pilot training to advanced ATCO certification, with both in-person and online delivery options.

## Key Topics

- ICAO Aviation English
- ICAO Level 4 Proficiency
- Commercial Pilot Training
- Air Traffic Control (ATCO)
- Radiotelephony Phraseology
- Basic Aeronautical Knowledge (BAK)
- Flight Training English
- Non-routine Situations
- Pilot Certification
- Hong Kong Aviation
- Private Pilot Licence (PPL)
- Cadet Entry Programs
- ICAO English Test Practice
- Online Aviation English
- Professional Development

## Pilot Training Programs

- [ICAO Aviation English for Commercial Pilots](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/icao-aviation-english-for-commercial-pilots.html): ICAO Aviation English course for commercial pilots in Hong Kong with MATF reimbursement
- [ICAO Aviation English for Cadet Entry Pilots](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/icao-aviation-english-for-cadet-entry-pilots.html): ICAO Aviation English training for CX cadet pilot programme entry preparation
- [Aviation English for Private Pilot Licence Ground School](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/english-for-ppl-ground-school.html): English language training for PPL ground school and flight training phases
- [Airline Pilot Interview Preparation](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/airline-pilot-interview-preparation.html): Airline pilot interview preparation with English language training for Hong Kong positions
- [English for Flight Training](https://aviationenglish.com/bak-certificate-programme/english-for-flight-training.html): English language training module for ground school and simulator flight training phases

## Air Traffic Control Training

- [ICAO Aviation English for Air Traffic Controllers](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/icao-aviation-english-for-atcos.html): ICAO Aviation English course for air traffic control officers and student ATCOs
- [ICAO Aviation English for Student Air Traffic Control Officers](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/icao-aviation-english-for-student-air-traffic-control-officers.html): Three-day ICAO Aviation English course for new-hire student ATCOs in Hong Kong

## Core ICAO Aviation English Courses

- [ICAO Aviation English for Pilots and ATCOs](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos.html): Main product page for ICAO Aviation English courses for pilots and air traffic controllers
- [ICAO Aviation English Test Practice](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/icao-aviation-english-test-practice.html): Mock ICAO Aviation English test practice sessions with expert feedback and guidance
- [ICAO Aviation English Online](http://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/icao-aviation-english-online.html): Online ICAO Aviation English course via Skype and Zoom for ICAO level 4 proficiency
- [ICAO Aviation English Online Tutorials](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/icao-aviation-english-online-tutorials.html): Live one-on-one ICAO Aviation English tutorials via Skype and Zoom worldwide

## Basic Aeronautical Knowledge Certificate Programme

- [Basic Aeronautical Knowledge Certificate Programme](https://aviationenglish.com/bak-certificate-programme/basic-aeronautical-knowledge-certificate-programme.html): Detailed BAK certificate programme covering aeronautical theory and English language
- [Basic Aeronautical Knowledge Certificate Programme Module 2](https://aviationenglish.com/bak-certificate-programme/basic-aeronautical-knowledge-certificate-programme-module-2.html): BAK certificate module 2 covering aircraft performance, meteorology and operations
- [Radiotelephony 101](https://aviationenglish.com/bak-certificate-programme/radiotelephony-101.html): 10-hour foundation course in radiotelephony phraseology and pilot radio communication
- [English for Non-routine Situations](https://aviationenglish.com/bak-certificate-programme/english-for-non-routine-situations.html): English language training for non-routine cockpit situations and emergency communication

## In-Person Classes & Programs

- [Classes for Pilots and ATCs](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/classes-for-pilots-and-atcs.html): In-person aviation English classes for pilots and ATCs in Central Hong Kong
- [Supplementary Classes for Pilots and ATCs](https://aviationenglish.com/english-for-pilots-and-atcos/supplementary-classes.html): Supplementary English classes for pilots, ATCs and aircraft engineers in Hong Kong

## Programme Overview

- [English Courses for Pilots, ATCs, Engineers and Cabin Crew](https://aviationenglish.com): Homepage for Aviation English Asia Ltd, ICAO Aviation English training provider based in Hong Kong
- [Basic Aeronautical Knowledge Certificate Programme](https://aviationenglish.com/bak-certificate-programme.html): Basic Aeronautical Knowledge certificate programme for pilots and aviation professionals
